name: event-sequence-dsh-mapped
notes: Sparse fixture proving the mapping rule of DSHEventMapper.swift:25-33: harness seq = dsh seq * 8 + part, so durable seq starts at 0 and leaves gaps whenever one DSH event carries fewer parts than the slot width. Resuming after harness seq 1 re-maps DSH event 0 and skips its parts 0 and 1, so the next delivered seq is 8 (DSHEventMapper.swift:5-8, AgentHarness.swift:490-494). A host MUST therefore treat seq as an ordinal cursor, never as a count of events.
